quickly

adverb

quick·​ly
ˈkwiklē, 
-li
Synonyms of quickly
1
: in a quick manner: such as
a
: rapidly, speedily
had got rich quickly—J. D. Hart
b
: without delay : soon
said she would hear from him quickly
2
archaic : in a sensitively responsive manner : with sensitivity
the language was still too rich and stiff to turn and twist quickly and freely upon half a sheet of notepaper—Virginia Woolf

Word History

Etymology

Middle English quikly, from quik, quike quick + -ly
